notes: Fetched from the Nokogiri v1.19.4 commit with a blob:none partial fetch plus sparse checkout of 'gumbo-parser/' only; only vendor/src/gumbo/gumbo-parser/** is kept (no Ruby tree): CHANGES.md, Makefile, fuzzer/, gperf-filter.sed, src/, test/, THANKS.md. C sources are the 17 files listed in upstream gumbo-parser/src/Makefile (generated gperf tag/attribute tables are committed and were not regenerated; no gperf/ragel run). Built with clang preserving upstream -std=c99 -Wall. Probe parses two small documents with the nokogiri_gumbo.h API: doc1 checks root html, head/body split, title/body/p/b/text nodes and attribute name/value pairs, and byte-exact serialization by a minimal tree walker; doc2 checks HTML5 implied <body> and <tbody> insertion for a table and its serialization. Both serializations match the expected strings byte-for-byte.
